people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Horonites
people.line: A people group opposed to Nehemiah's work.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Sanballat
people.line: Governor of Samaria, opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem

people.name: Tobiah
people.line: Ammonite official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding efforts

translations.web: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: But when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about this, they were deeply disturbed that someone had come to seek the well-being of the Israelites.
translations.kjv: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, for that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
